name: Epic Envenomed Cloak
upgradeable: Legendary Crafting to Legendary Envenomed Cloak

effects.name: Greater Poison Guard
effects.tooltip: Greater Poison Guard : This item carries a potent venom that may be contracted by enemies that hit you, dealing 2d6 Strength damage. A successful Fortitude Save (DC 28) will negate this effect.

effects.name: Constitution
effects.tooltip: Constitution +9 : This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +9 Enhancement bonus to Constitution.

effects.name: Resistance
effects.tooltip: Resistance +8 : Passive: +8 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.

effects.name: Proof Against Poison
effects.tooltip: Proof Against Poison +8 : This item grants its wearer immunity to natural poisons. This item also grants a +8 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical poisons, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical poisons with a DC of less than 9 + their Fortitude save).

effects.name: Epic Might of the Abishai
effects.tooltip: Epic Might of the Abishai : 3 Piece Equipped: +10 Profane bonus to PRR and MRR +5 Profane bonus to Natural Armor +2 Profane bonus to all Ability Scores +2 Profane bonus to DCs 5 Piece Equipped: +15 Profane bonus to PRR and MRR +8 Profane bonus to Natural Armor +2 Profane bonus to all Ability Scores +2 Profane bonus to DCs

flavor_text: A cloak with spikes that have been steeped in a dangerous poison. Enemies that attack the wearer may be subject to the effects of the venom that coats the cloak's barbs.
